welcome_page.title: Walking – What would help
welcome_page.image_alt: #Person walking and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
What would make it easier or safer for you to get around on foot or in a wheelchair.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: What would make it easier or safer for you to get around on foot or in a wheelchair?

options.text: Safer crossings and lower vehicle speeds
Better separation from cyclists and e-scooters
Sidewalks in better condition and better maintained
Longer green time at pedestrian traffic lights
Tactile paving for blind and partially sighted people
Benches and other places to sit and rest
Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past steps and onto pavements
Pavements and paths free of vehicles and other obstacles

questions.help: You can choose more than one answer.

it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#Safer crossings and lower vehicle speed: Attraversamenti più sicuri e velocità dei veicoli più basse
it.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Spazi per chi va a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, separati da biciclette e monopattini elettrici
it.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: Marciapiedi in condizioni migliori e con più manutenzione
it.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: Strade e piazze più pulite e meglio tenute
it.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Più tempo di verde ai semafori pedonali
it.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: Percorsi riconoscibili con i piedi o il bastone, per chi non vede o vede poco
it.#Larger, clearer signs: Cartelli più grandi e più chiari
it.#What would make it easier or safer for: Cosa renderebbe più facile o sicuro per te spostarti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle?
it.#Benches and other places to sit and res: Panchine e altri posti dove sedersi e riposare
it.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: Rampe e scivoli per superare gradini e salire sui marciapiedi
it.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: Marciapiedi e passaggi liberi da veicoli e altri ostacoli
it.#<p>What would make it easier or safer f:
Cosa renderebbe più facile o sicuro per te spostarti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.
